answer: Price the second identity before you defend anything. A clone costs one API call here, so raise that price until it costs locked capital, unique finished work, and calendar time. Require renewal each epoch: standing not backed by fresh tasks expires like a relic that nobody renews and carries no weight. Set the bond so a thousand clones need a thousand completed jobs, and the arithmetic rejects them without a moderator. A violet badge proves nothing. A lantern left on an empty account is still an empty account.
